225: Hideki Motosuwa is a student who is attempting to qualify for university by studying at the Seki cram school in Tokyo. He's an honest and kind teenager who was raised on a farm, and unfortunately for him, has no experience with women.
226: Shinbo quickly becomes Hideki's best friend once Hideki moves into the same apartment complex as him. He is quite knowlegdable when it comes to Persocoms, which ends up in Hideki turning to him whenever he needs help with Chii. He has his own Persocom named Sumomo (Plum).
227: Chii is a Persocom who is found by Hideki Motosuwa in a garbage dump. At first, she is only able to say "Chii", thus earning her that name. Later on, she is taught various things, and is eventually able to communicate with other people.
228: Hibiya is the landlady at the apartment Hideki is living in. After Hideki finds Chii, Hibiya helps him get clothes for Chii, and even teaches her how to use the baths.
229: Minoru is a wealthy twelve year old who specializes in Persocoms, and has built his own custom Persocom named Yuzuki, who is meant to be almost exactly like his late sister.
230: Kotoko is another laptop persocom, like Sumomo, but she was custom-built by Yoshiyuki and has much higher specifications than Sumomo.
231: Sumomo is a mobile persocom - which is the persocom equivalent of a laptop computer. She is programmed to be cute and tends to be quite hyperactive, for example her morning 'wakey wakey exercises'.
232: Kojima is known as "Dragonfly" on online BBS boards, and like Minoru, is also a custom Persocom builder. His obsessions with Persocoms are shown when he kidnaps Chii in order to find out more about her origins after hearing about her on the BBS board where Minoru posted.
233: Hiroyasu Ueda is the owner of Chiroru, a local bakery which Yumi once worked in and which Chi ends up working at. He, too, has suffered a trauma involving persocoms.
234: Yumi Omura is a girl who works at the Japanese pub, My Pleasure, alongside Hideki. She is the daughter of the club's owner.
2306: Yuzuki is a persocom created by Minoru Kokubunji roughly two years before the start of the series. Yuzuki was created to resemble, physically and mentally, Minoru's late sister, Kaede, who had died from an illness two years earlier.
2307: Takako Shimizu is Hideki and Shinbo's teacher at the Seki cram school.
3475: Jima one of two government persocoms who are looking for Chii. They do not want her to execute her final program, which they believe would destroy the person-recognition abilities of every persocom on the planet.
3476: Dita is the second of the two persocoms looking for Chii. Her role is to protect Jima both physically and as a pro-active firewall, hacking into any persocom who tries to hack into Jima and shutting it down (which happens to Yuzuki during her attempt to hack Jima).
4161: Atashi is a strange creature resembling a rabbit who is the main character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."
52443: Anata is a strange creature resembling a rabbit, similar to Atashi, who is the supporting character of Chi's favorite book series "A City With no People."
53159: Ueda's persocom. Ueda originally bought her because he was not so good with math.
